subject: Shiny website examples don't show up on ubuntu 12.04

messages.author: 2f94624d7ac6c2a0
messages.subject: Shiny website examples don't show up on ubuntu 12.04
parts:
Hello everyone, 

Someone just recommended to me that I look into shiny to produce a R based web-app. So far, things work well when I launch an example from R. But I have trouble seeing the examples from the website on linux (Ubuntu).
For example, I don't see the actual plot but only the sliders and check box for this example: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/stocks/ 

I've tried with Firefox 22.0 on and Chromium Version 28.0.1500.52 on Ubuntu 12.04 LTS, and with Safari on IOS. I am not able to see the examples with any of those browsers.

Am I missing something obvious? Are there client-side requirements for shiny to work?

Thank you very much!

Frederic
